pull_quotes.after_paragraph: The biggest change is disclosure. A private company files
pull_quotes.quote: A private company files its accounts once a year with the Registrar of Companies and that is largely it. A listed company must file quarterly results, annual reports, details of every related-party transaction, and immediate disclosures of any material event.
pull_quotes.rationale: Captures the dramatic shift in compliance burden after listing, reinforcing the trade-off of going public.
